$comment: Generated by `npm run music:sync` from the Spotify Web API. Do not hand-edit
anything below this comment — a sync overwrites it. The comment itself is
preserved across syncs, so it is the one thing here a human owns.
`tracks` empty is the off state: the homepage then renders no ON ROTATION
section at all, rather than a placeholder that sits there looking broken.
Refresh any time with:  npm run music:sync
If that reports invalid_grant the consent was revoked, and
`npm run music:auth` issues a new refresh token — note that it only prints
the line, it does not write .env.
See the header of scripts/spotify-sync.mjs for what the fields mean and
README.md for the three credentials it needs.
